name: shiro
description: Browser-native Unix shell with Git, pipes, and IndexedDB filesystem - no servers, runs entirely in JavaScript

scripts.build: tsc && vite build && node scripts/write-profiles.mjs && node scripts/build-browse.mjs
scripts.test: cd tests && npx vitest run --config vitest.config.ts
scripts.conformance: (sh scripts/conformance/fetch.sh || echo "conformance: could not fetch external suites; they will be skipped") && cd tests && npx vitest run --config vitest.conformance.config.ts; node ../scripts/conformance/report.mjs
